_note: TEST VECTORS for the referral-name signed message (REFERRAL-NAMES-CONTRACT.md section 2). The keys are obviously-test keys, never real: the EVM key is the well-known anvil/hardhat account 0, the Solana seed is 32 bytes of 0x01. Both signature schemes are deterministic (EIP-191 personal_sign with RFC 6979; ed25519), so a kit that signs the same message must produce the same signature. `message` is the byte-exact UTF-8 string (lines joined with LF, no trailing newline).
